purpose: Freeze exactly one opt-in source-aligned implementation candidate after the Phase91 alignment and clock/ISB unit audit. Raw execution, accuracy scoring, route selection, and submission are not authorized by this freeze.

decision_boundary.implementation_scope: focused code, tests, and diagnostics for the candidate below only

candidate.scope: opt-in main GTSAM Pose3+IMU batch graph on the existing same-run in-memory GNSS-first raw path

handoff_contract.raw_staging: same-run native raw device GNSS plus raw device IMU plus broadcast navigation
handoff_contract.gnss_first: same retained in-memory raw GNSS problem, optimized before the main GNSS+IMU graph
handoff_contract.position_clock_velocity: same-run GNSS-first result copied through the existing in-memory handoff
handoff_contract.retained_epoch_identity: exact source index, integer raw UTC millisecond key, and GNSS week/TOW identity

retained_raw_d_alignment.purpose: Correct the Phase91 validator's comparison of retained epochs against unfiltered raw vectors without relaxing any coverage gate.
retained_raw_d_alignment.mapping: Every retained main EpochSeed and corresponding GNSS-first epoch/solution key maps exactly once, in source order, to its retained raw source index and raw UTC key.
retained_raw_d_alignment.raw_d_source: receiver_clock_drift_mps from that exact same-run retained raw epoch/key
retained_raw_d_alignment.filtered_raw_epochs: raw epochs filtered out before the retained problem may remain unmatched

state_units.public_PositionSolution_receiver_clock_b: seconds, obtained by dividing final C by C_LIGHT exactly once

official_equations.pseudorange: range + C_i + ISB_group + signal_bias + ionosphere - P
official_equations.equivalence: the metre row is the official seconds row multiplied by C_LIGHT; do not alter the physical equation or sigma

unit_conversion_contract.plain_and_isb_pseudorange: base C and ISB enter directly in metres with unit derivatives; signal-bias and ionosphere terms remain metres
unit_conversion_contract.clock_motion_and_prior: use existing physical metre sigmas directly with metre C state; preserve edge, gap, and jump rules
unit_conversion_contract.source_clock_c0d: C metres, D metres_per_second, dt seconds, residual/Jacobian/sigma as frozen above
unit_conversion_contract.undifferenced_doppler: D remains direct metres_per_second with no C_LIGHT conversion
unit_conversion_contract.tdcp_and_carrier_phase: use a metre-aware equivalent or an explicit audited seconds boundary for any enabled factor; never mix a metre C key with a seconds-clock factor
unit_conversion_contract.stock_carrier_phase_api: if enabled, keep its documented seconds boundary explicit and convert only at that factor boundary
unit_conversion_contract.residual_diagnostics: report C and ISB metre states directly; apply no second C_LIGHT multiplication to metre states
unit_conversion_contract.public_output: convert C metres to public seconds once at PositionSolution output; retain existing public API
unit_conversion_contract.optimizer: unchanged GTSAM batch Levenberg-Marquardt algorithm and parameters
unit_conversion_contract.source_sigma: unchanged official C0D sigma 0.1 m; no tuning
unit_conversion_contract.direct_quality: unchanged raw direct P+D quality, masks, and source sigmas

required_implementation_tests: retained-key map accepts filtered-out raw epochs while requiring every retained key exactly once and in order

retained-key map rejects missing, nonfinite, duplicate, reordered, time-misaligned, week/TOW-misaligned, nearest, interpolated, padded, truncated, zero, hold, WLS, residual, and coordinate-derived values
raw D is finite and fully covered for every retained epoch with no fallback
C and ISB are metre-valued, D is metres_per_second, and C0D residual/Jacobian/sigma match the frozen official row
plain/ISB pseudorange, optional carrier/TDCP, clock motion, priors, diagnostics, and public output use one consistent unit boundary
default-off selector leaves legacy behavior unchanged
same-run GNSS-first handoff, raw P+D quality, no-PDC, and no-coordinate-copy invariants remain enforced
synthetic accepted active solve emits complete recognized termination telemetry
future active-solve gates remain finite costs, iterations >= 1, and final_cost < initial_cost

future_execution_boundary.execution_on_failure: fail closed; do not tune sigma, alter the equation/Jacobian, relax retained-key coverage, add a route, or open accuracy artifacts
